items.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton. The article Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 的運作方式與其他 AI 模型不同，它不會產生影像。這個語言模型不會去計算像素，而是編寫 Python 程式碼，在虛擬畫布上配置數十萬個模擬筆觸，並具備刷毛質感與顏料塗布效果。Anthropic 員工 Jake Eaton 表示，單單一個逼真的停車場場景就大約花費了 700,000 個筆觸。

items.title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
items.summary: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers. Author Mike Major cautions against jumping to conclusions, however, noting that business cycle shifts and remote work trends could also explain the numbers. The article Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 澳洲央行發現早期跡象顯示，人工智慧正在衝擊高度曝險職位（如軟體開發和客戶服務）的年輕入門員工。自 ChatGPT 推出以來，這些領域中 15 至 24 歲族群的職缺與就業率下降幅度，比年長員工更為劇烈。不過，作家麥克・梅傑（Mike Major）警告切勿妄下定論，並指出景氣迴圈轉變和遠距工作趨勢也可能是這些資料的原因。

items.title: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
items.summary: Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. On Terminal Bench, it scores 88.4 points, landing just behind Claude Opus 5. The sample deployment runs on 194 Huawei Ascend chips, and Meituan makes no mention of Nvidia GPUs. The article Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: 不調用圖像模型，Claude Fable5.2用70萬次筆觸畫出一輛購物車
items.summary: Anthropic 11月9日發佈 Claude Fable5.2 與 Mythos5.2。Fable5.2 無傳統文生圖模型，卻能以代碼在虛擬畫布逐筆作畫，還原筆刷紋理、顏料溼度與畫布質感，並可修正錯誤。它不同於 Midjourney 等擴散模型從噪聲生成圖像，而是把繪畫拆解爲筆觸指令執行，每幅畫是一段約1000至2000行 Python 程序，不依賴圖像模型或預渲染底圖。員工 Jake Eaton 在 X 展示該能力。

source_material.title: 蘋果首款AI眼鏡計劃2027年WWDC亮相，年底前上市
source_material.summary: 科技博主Mark Gurman披露，蘋果計劃於2027年6月WWDC發佈首款AI智能眼鏡，預計2027年底前上市，內部代號N50，硬件設計已基本定型。該眼鏡比Meta二代Ray-Ban更纖薄，攝像頭集成在鏡框內無凸起，提供多種款式配色，並優化音質、傳感器和佩戴體驗。功能上首代產品信息未完整披露。

items.title: 豆包 App 上線“找店”:商家批量標註地圖，團購下單與一鍵導航在對話內閉環
items.summary: 據《讀佳》報道，字節跳動豆包App上線“找店”功能：商家批量標註在地圖上，點門店圖標可直達商家頁看團購套餐並下單，也可一鍵導航，將找店、比價、下單、出行收攏於同一對話頁。繼“出行用豆包”超級入口打通打車、導航與酒店預訂後，這是豆包本地生活場景的再次落地，也不同於此前AI推薦餐廳僅返回文字清單。

items_ai.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
items_ai.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton. The article Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 的運作方式與其他 AI 模型不同，它不會產生影像。這個語言模型不會去計算像素，而是編寫 Python 程式碼，在虛擬畫布上配置數十萬個模擬筆觸，並具備刷毛質感與顏料塗布效果。Anthropic 員工 Jake Eaton 表示，單單一個逼真的停車場場景就大約花費了 700,000 個筆觸。

Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers. Author Mike Major cautions against jumping to conclusions, however, noting that business cycle shifts and remote work trends could also explain the numbers. items_ai.title: 不調用圖像模型，Claude Fable5.2用70萬次筆觸畫出一輛購物車
items_ai.summary: Anthropic 11月9日發佈 Claude Fable5.2 與 Mythos5.2。Fable5.2 無傳統文生圖模型，卻能以代碼在虛擬畫布逐筆作畫，還原筆刷紋理、顏料溼度與畫布質感，並可修正錯誤。它不同於 Midjourney 等擴散模型從噪聲生成圖像，而是把繪畫拆解爲筆觸指令執行，每幅畫是一段約1000至2000行 Python 程序，不依賴圖像模型或預渲染底圖。員工 Jake Eaton 在 X 展示該能力。
